# Verification MCP

> Fact-check claims against Wikipedia + Wikidata + Crossref. Verify citations. Check source freshness

This MCP server exposes 3 tools via the Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST). It runs on Cloudflare Workers and is billed via Dodo Payments. Authenticated via `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` obtained by subscribing at `https://verification-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade`.

## Endpoint
- MCP JSON-RPC: https://verification-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/mcp
- Health: https://verification-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/health
- Landing page: https://verification-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/
- Get API key: https://verification-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade?tier=solo

## Tools
- `fact_check`: Verify a factual claim against Wikipedia + Wikidata + Crossref. Returns verdict + supporting passages.
- `cite_check`: Verify cited URLs resolve, match the cited claim, and aren't retracted.
- `source_freshness`: Check whether a source URL is live + last-modified + most-recent Wayback snapshot.

## Authentication
Pass `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on POST /mcp. Free tier: anonymous, 100 calls / month / IP.

## Pricing
- Free: 100 calls / month (anonymous, no signup)
- Solo $19/mo: 2,000 calls / month, 60/min
- Team $49/mo: 10,000 calls / month, 200/min, 5 team seats
- Pro $149/mo: 50,000 calls / month, 600/min, 25 team seats
Billed via Dodo Payments (merchant-of-record). Cancel anytime.
